summary: First-run frontend-only test of PRINTKING premium packaging site. Verified homepage load, 3D hero canvas, counters, all 13 sections, navigation, testimonials rotator, machinery lightbox, portfolio filter & lightbox, quote form (empty validation + valid submission), Request-a-Quote 3-step wizard, WhatsApp floating button, mobile menu toggle, and all 6 inner pages. NO runtime-error overlay and NO page errors observed. WhatsApp deep-link fallback verified for both quote forms (EmailJS keys intentionally not configured).

tests_executed.homepage_load: PASS - title set, canvas rendered (3D hero), no runtime error overlay, no pageerror, no fatal console errors
tests_executed.hero_ctas: PASS - Request a Quote (top nav + hero) -> /request-quote ; View Our Work -> /portfolio
tests_executed.sections_rendered: PASS - trusted marquee, about, manufacturing, services, industries, machinery, sustainability, testimonials (data-testid testimonial-next visible), machinery grid (data-testid machine-0), quote form (data-testid quote-form) all present
tests_executed.testimonials_rotator: PASS - testimonial-next click changes the quote text (verified before/after differ)
tests_executed.machinery_lightbox: PASS - clicking machine-0 opens a [role=dialog]; Escape closes it
tests_executed.portfolio_filters: PASS - 12 filter buttons exist; filtering by 'cosmetics-&-beauty' reduces items from 9 -> 2; portfolio-item-0 click opens lightbox dialog
tests_executed.quote_form_empty: PASS - empty submit triggers validation toast: 'Please enter your full name.'
tests_executed.quote_form_valid_whatsapp_fallback: PASS - valid submission calls window.open with https://wa.me/923000000000?text=*New%20Quote%20Request*... and shows toast: 'Opening WhatsApp to send your request… Email delivery isn’t configured yet — your details are pre-filled in WhatsApp.' No crash.
tests_executed.request_quote_wizard: PASS - product-rigid-box selectable, wizard-next advances steps 1->2->3, wizard-name/company/email accept input, wizard-submit triggers WhatsApp deep-link with Product Type=Rigid Box embedded
tests_executed.mobile_menu_toggle: PASS - data-testid=mobile-menu-toggle exists on mobile viewport (390x844); after click the nav links (About/Services/Portfolio/Machinery/Sustainability/Contact) become visible
tests_executed.inner_pages: PASS - /about /services /portfolio /machinery /sustainability /contact all load with no runtime error overlay

critical_code_review_comments: Hero 'Request a Quote' and 'View Our Work' are <button onClick=navigate> rather than <a href> — functional, but using <Link>/<a> would improve SEO/accessibility (open-in-new-tab, right-click) and avoid the (harmless) issue where one of the duplicate buttons remained offscreen during the test. Not blocking.
Filter testids use raw labels with spaces/ampersands encoded (e.g. filter-cosmetics-&-beauty). Works but consider slugifying to filter-cosmetics-beauty for cleaner selectors.
Form fallback toast wording is good and informs the user EmailJS is not configured — user-friendly behavior; recommended to keep as-is.
